svg.title: sand-agent: a live agent chat about Kyle Touchet, typed from public GitHub history
svg.desc: Q: hey, who's Sand? Kyle Touchet, better known around here as Sand. AI Native Product Engineer. Ships AI-native products end to end. Currently teaching software to coach humans out loud. The headline act is LadderStar: AI voice coach. Rehearse conversations, presentations and interviews out loud, get feedback, try again. Q: any stats? 147 contributions, 6 mo, 24 active days, 3 days, best streak, 20 on the busiest day This week so far: 9 contributions and 13 pull request events. Q: what else is on the workbench? port-visualizer (TypeScript, 3 stars): Windows desktop app for inspecting, monitoring, and managing active network ports: live diffing, process-grouped views, and safe process termination. TypeScript + Electron. godotion (GDScript, 1 star): A motion-graphics timeline editor plugin for Godot 4. Scene nodes become tracks, drawn with Godot's own editor icons and theme. Q: show me another project BloodHound (TypeScript): A fast, safety-first canine bloodwork and nutrition discussion guide aeronautics_delivery_quests (Java, 1 star): Procedural airship hauling contracts for Create: Aeronautics: physics-compiled cargo, quest compasses, and dry-land route generation. NeoForge 1.21.1. Q: got anything weirder? aeronautics_preflight_checklist (Java, 1 star): Client-side preflight diagnostics for Create: Aeronautics airships: mass, lift, balance, and thrust torque analysis before launch.
